# HT-301 raw transport fixtures

These two 224,256-byte frames were captured from the connected HT-301 on
2026-09-26 using OpenCV's V4L2 backend with RGB conversion disabled. Both
retain the observed 384 × 292 YUYV transport structure and the known numeric
parameter offsets. The camera identifier was erased from two trailer ranges.

| Fixture | SHA-256 | Scene treatment | Transport center Y | Native trailer center index | Block field 356 |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `scene-a.raw` | `90006c5ec49e82b126cd961d074d38840013e654939522b9c18e977ca818353b` | YUYV four-byte groups shuffled outside an 8 × 8 center patch to anonymize a person | 96 | 5165 | 35.99200058 |
| `scene-b.raw` | `37578b11b89656ff3220f711721195f250613a7ab85086fa6f3d0b3243cfbb7d` | Spatial scene retained after visual inspection found no identifying content | 107 | 5255 | 35.99200058 |

Both have reflected and ambient temperatures of 25 °C, humidity ≈ 0.45,
emissivity ≈ 0.98, distance = 1, and calibration coefficient 0 ≈ 0.2705.
All 288 image rows are retained; rows 288–291 are trailer. `scene-a.raw` has
a valid image Y maximum of 243, whereas treating the whole 292-row transport
as an image yields 255 in row 291.

The two scenes differ strongly in mean Y (83.99 versus 109.75), but field 356
is identical. It is a copy of the coefficient at byte 223498, while the native
live center indices at byte 221208 differ. Every image word has a `0x80` high
byte, putting it above the Android lookup's 14-bit range. These fixtures do
not provide expected Celsius values. The shuffled scene is unsuitable for
spatial or center-region inference beyond its preserved center patch.

## First radiometric fixture (2026-09-26)

`radiometric-initial.raw` is the surviving sanitized frame from the final
stage of the official `32772 -> 32800 -> 32768` replay, after 15 settling
frames. Its image min/max is 4715/4864; every complete uint16 pixel is below
0x4000. Spatial groups were shuffled outside the center patch and both known
identifier spans cleared. Extrema coordinates therefore cannot be checked
against the shuffled image. This fixture's scene has no independently
measured reference temperature.

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `radiometric-initial.raw` | `aae1437a8e5d1f0f7dce03d9c14687545ad27bcc0ea3362d4664b5a5ba337815` |
| `radiometric-initial-native-lut.npy` | `c262c99d3569ecb245f78bca8b21085c60876fda0407e9769ac483ab03c3cd04` |

The `.npy` file stores the 16384 float32 values generated by executing the
hash-pinned official x86_64 `libthermometry.so` (library SHA-256
`00fc62661ec6d407ecc8b2dd14a1d136701a386bd8f4b9e1ee342f8b42e7addd`).
This is generated numerical reference data, not a bundled native binary.
Host state is range 120, lens 68, shutter fix 1.5. The unwrapped float32 table
SHA-256 is `0d1ef968c0f2923c31b508ac51f2021b68bd74cc1a55a5fb6c9436ae8495e13a`.
It contains 13264 finite entries and native undefined entries below that
region. Selected observed indices are finite.

Trailer center/high/low indices are 4844/4864/4715, yielding native outputs
16.282669/16.800127/12.868019 °C. FPA word 221186 is 7180 (37.222221 after
transform); calibration word 223490 is 3105 (37.350006 after its different
transform). Correction is 0, reflected/ambient 25, humidity about .45,
emissivity about .98, and stored distance 1; native lens 68 uses effective
distance 3. All five calibration coefficients remain present.

The raw fixture and reference survived the interrupted session unchanged.
The original temporary JSON reports did not. A clearly labeled summary from
session output is in `docs/diagnostics/2026-09-26-recorded-summary.json`.
Both repositories' entire uncommitted work was archived with SHA-256 manifests
in persistent research storage before resumption. Native execution was
repeated after resumption and reproduced this saved table exactly.

Ordinary tests compare every lookup entry, including its NaN pattern, with
absolute tolerance 0.0001 °C to allow small host-libm differences. The measured
maximum difference on this host was zero. These checks establish arithmetic
reproducibility, not physical temperature accuracy or ARM/x86 equivalence.

## Spatial room sequence (2026-09-27)

The complete original captures and reports are retained in persistent
`LMThermal-Research/analysis/warm-target-20260927/` storage. The following
selected frames preserve image layout while clearing the two known identifier
spans. A room/ceiling scene was visible; **no hand or independent surface
reference** was present. The separate manifest at
`docs/diagnostics/2026-09-27-fixtures.json` records source frames, numeric
trailer/calibration data and the corresponding native lookup table hashes.

| Fixture | SHA-256 | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `display-room-baseline.raw` | `d9daecccb563d15386b32f290c33caf564661f0fd3f3581077dfec4129a0248b` | Display `0x80YY` baseline; not a LUT input |
| `radiometric-room-first.raw` | `8e5eb648c7dd632aae7810e89b86633ef79a5cf490b33ff364171cd0c0e80747` | First confirmed raw14 frame after `32772`; mode evidence, not equilibrium evidence |
| `radiometric-room-range.raw` | `02c9ef0090da53e322265a36e92bbc53717433951941732838404633db96242d` | Raw14 after `32800`; stage evidence |
| `radiometric-room-shutter-held.raw` | `fc1de1c0993e05c851f5aa80032d4b61d66677a2510f44c511030bc60426e2da` | Held/transient post-`32768` frame; unsuitable for steady-state validation |
| `radiometric-room-settled.raw` | `fde6a4b803b68fcea07ab7b428f4769d22e896f01055969f43102bdc9270f5d6` | Later settled raw14 regression frame from a read-only run |

The initial post-shutter 15-frame discard was too short in the second run;
the held period lasted about 1.3 seconds. The diagnostic now discards at least
75 post-shutter frames before selecting a candidate. A later 75-frame window
contained 75 distinct raw14 images, with center/high/low lookup standard
deviations of about 0.029/0.017/0.039 °C. The room region comparison is in
`docs/diagnostics/2026-09-27-room-stability.json`. Short-term liveness and
repeatability do not prove physical accuracy or long-term calibration stability.

## Operator-confirmed hand fixture (2026-09-29)

`warm-hand-settled.raw` is a 224,256-byte frame from
`LMThermal-Research/analysis/warm-target-20260929/hand-run-01/captures/E_post_shutter_stability/frame-045.raw`.
SHA-256: `c31fda649ec08740e6ec2744dec037006c87b96ccfa685ca44d453615e50f4ae`.
The operator confirmed a hand in the central view; the saved image retains
the spatial hand/background structure. The two known identifier spans were
cleared without changing image pixels, trailer indices or calibration values.
The fixture is from a 23-frame run of distinct raw14 images after a separate
31-frame held interval; it is a regression and relative-discrimination
fixture, not a physical-temperature standard.

For this frame, image words span 5340–5783 and the experimental full matrix
spans 27.748–37.379 °C. The trailer center is index 5740 / 36.483 °C;
literal pixel `(192,144)` is index 5742 / 36.525 °C. High is index 5783 at
`(191,211)` on the visible hand, 37.379 °C; low is index 5340 at `(329,83)`
in the cooler background, 27.748 °C. The central 32 × 32 palm ROI averages
36.578 °C and the lower-left background ROI 27.996 °C. Detailed ROI
min/max, within-frame variation, lookup inputs and provenance are in
`docs/diagnostics/2026-09-29-hand-discrimination.json`. No independent
surface reference was measured.
